params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in the response. Anonymous callers may only use `view` and `embed`.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items to be returned in the result set.

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a string.

params.name: after
params.description: Limit response to items published after a given ISO 8601 compliant date.

params.name: before
params.description: Limit response to items published before a given ISO 8601 compliant date.

params.name: exclude
params.description: Ensure result set excludes specific IDs.

params.name: include
params.description: Limit result set to specific IDs.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset the result set by a specific number of items.

params.name: order
params.description: Order sort attribute ascending or descending.

params.name: _fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to limit the response to. The most effective way to keep page-body responses small on this site, where `content.rendered` can exceed 100KB.

params.name: media_type
params.description: Limit the result set to attachments of a particular media type.

params.name: mime_type
params.description: Limit the result set to attachments of a particular MIME type.

items.docs: Lists media library attachments. 247 items at harvest time — company logos, leadership headshots, mechanism-of-action diagrams and press-release imagery. Each item carries `source_url` plus a `media_details.sizes` map of generated renditions.
